a: OKRs set Objectives and measurable Key Results.
ICE prioritizes by Impact, Confidence, Ease.
Kano classifies features as basic, performance, or delighters.
Journey maps show steps, emotions, and pain points.
Personas summarize target user types from research.
Betas gather feedback before wide release.
Track meaningful events, not vanity clicks alone.
Experiments should respect users and avoid harmful manipulation.
Communicate timelines and migrations when removing features.
Align stakeholders on goals before large builds.
